response.content: {"findings":[{"location":"HTML, paragraph beginning “Then, a rich voice spoke inside me”","severity":"major","source_quote":"“The true prayers of your heart can be answered, If you would only but look unto Me.”","suggested_fix":"Replace the final line of this stanza with: “Ikiwa ungenitazama Mimi tu.” (The translation currently means “if you look only at Me,” changing the conditional from “would” to a direct present condition.)","translation_quote":"“Ikiwa utanitazama Mimi tu.”"},{"location":"HTML, paragraph beginning “I ordered the rough ways you have followed”","severity":"major","source_quote":"“I ordered the rough ways you have followed, Not to disappoint, but to purge.”","suggested_fix":"Replace the first two lines with: “Nilipanga njia ngumu ulizopitia, / Si ili kukukatisha tamaa, bali ili kukutakasa.” (“Kukusafisha” can mean to clean physically; here “purge” refers to spiritual refining.)","translation_quote":"“Nilipanga njia ngumu ulizopita, / Si ili kukukatisha tamaa, bali ili kukusafisha.”"},{"location":"HTML, paragraph beginning “So I fell at the feet of my Master”","severity":"major","source_quote":"“So I fell at the feet of my Master”","suggested_fix":"Change “Bwana wangu” to “Mwalimu wangu” to preserve “Master” without changing it to “Lord,” as the source uses “Lord” separately in the next stanza.","translation_quote":"“Basi nikaanguka miguuni pa Bwana wangu”"},{"location":"HTML, paragraph beginning “I pray instead for humility”","severity":"major","source_quote":"“To lead me through the day.”","suggested_fix":"Replace “Uniongoze siku nzima” with “Unyenyekevu uniongoze siku nzima” so humility, rather than an unspecified “you,” is explicitly the subject leading the speaker.","translation_quote":"“Uniongoze siku nzima.”"},{"location":"HTML, paragraph beginning “If He rules the inmost being”","severity":"major","source_quote":"“Then nothing outside will disturb.”","suggested_fix":"Replace “Basi hakuna kitu cha nje kitakachonisumbua” with “Basi hakuna kitu cha nje kitakachosumbua” to retain the source’s general statement without adding “me.”","translation_quote":"“Basi hakuna kitu cha nje kitakachonisumbua.”"}],"passed":false,"score":88}
